incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: high tail latency (p99) on inference-prod-usw2. Alert: p99 > 900ms over 5m. Affected service: inference-runtime (route: /v1/generate). Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC12345. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/latency-p99.
Alex: acked — I'm taking this. oncall. pulling metrics now.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by Alex.
Maya: on infra. checking autoscaler, node pools, and KV cache eviction rates. seeing a sudden spike in concurrent requests to tokenization sidecar.
Jamal: any customer-facing errors? support reporting 502s?
Alex: support: a couple of timeouts and slow responses from chat-api customers, no major error rate increase in 5xx but client-side timeouts up. correlating.
Maya: kvcache evictions high, mem pressure on sidecars. autoscaler hasn't fired because pod readiness probes slow. suspect warmup/coldstart thrash after a small canary.
Alex: timeline — canary deployed ~1866659800 (20m ago). new image tag: model-q4-quant.
Tina: ping — if it's canary-related we should fallback to previous model. preparing rollback plan. :rotating_light:
Alex: grabbing quick dashboards. p95 ~ 300ms now, p99 ~ 1.15s over last 5m. qps normal.
Maya: checked node metrics — CPU fine, GPU memory and KV hit ratio drop visible. autoscaler shows pending scale actions blocked by image pull backoffs on two pods. logs:```
ImagePullBackOff:  "rpc error: code = Unknown desc = error pulling image"
kubelet: Liveness probe failed: timeout
```
Alex: good find — imagePullBackOff would explain the partial capacity loss. That + new model memory footprint causing cold starts.
Jamal: customer impact: chat-api latency for streaming generation affected for ~3% of requests (tail). support already triaged a handful of tickets (INC-EXT-789).
Tina: immediate mitigation: 1) scale up older rollout (fallback) 2) restart stuck pods 3) disable canary rollout. I'll run commands.
Maya: starting pod restarts on stuck nodes, and triggering manual scale to handle current load.
Alex: running hot-swap to previous model variant (model-q3). applying canary rollback now.
Maya: executing:```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --to-revision=42
kubectl scale deployment/inference-runtime --replicas=30 -n prod
```
Alex: rollback initiated. pods coming up. watch shows new pods hitting ready. p99 trending down slowly.
pagerduty-bot: INC12345 escalated: if not resolved in 5m will notify next rotation.
Maya: manual scale done, restarted 4 backoff pods. KV cache hit rate recovering.
Alex: metrics: p95 280ms, p99 560ms (2m after rollback).
Jamal: support note: notifying affected customers that we're mitigating; ETA to full recovery 10-15m.
Tina: good. keep monitoring for 30m. if p99 stays >750ms we reopen escalation. prepping handoff notes. :white_check_mark:
Alex: confirming no errors in model repo; build logs show transient registry timeout causing image pulls to fail — pushing alert to infra team to check registry health.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 status changed to acknowledged -> under investigation.
Maya: KV cache warming; p99 now 420ms. streaming sessions stable.
Alex: will stay on until stabilization, then handoff to next oncall in 25m. leaving notes: rollback to model-q3, scaled to 30 replicas, restarted 4 pods, root cause likely image registry transient + higher memory footprint on q4.
Tina: thanks. I'll update the runbook with the image-pull backoff checklist and add a step to verify model memory on canary before promotion.
pagerduty-bot: INC12345: Alert condition cleared (p99 < 750ms for 5m). Auto-resolving.
Alex: marking as resolved from oncall perspective; will file postmortem if we see recurrence. handoff in 20m to Jamal.
Jamal: ack, I'll take the 20m watch and follow up with infra on registry reliability.
incident-bot: Note: next oncall is Jamal at 1866661200.
Tina: nice triage everyone. :thumbsup:
